<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="core-eda-flow" name="EDA flow"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="1060" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="1060" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="EDAAnalyzer: what analyze() computes" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="900" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_df" value="Polars DataFrame
EDAAnalyzer(df): NaN becomes
null; date-like strings
are cast to dates" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="50" width="220" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_opts" value="analyze() options
target_col, exclude_cols,
filters, task_type,
date_col, lat_col, lon_col" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="50" width="220" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_over" value="1. Overview
filters and column exclusions applied;
row and column counts, duplicate rows,
missing-cell %, memory use" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="50" width="420" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_types" value="2. Column types
Numeric, Categorical, Boolean,
DateTime, Text (otherwise Unknown)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="190" width="420" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_col" value="3. Per-column profiles
stats and histogram by type, missing count,
normality test, IQR outlier hint,
text length and sentiment (vaderSentiment)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="310" width="420" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_corr" value="4. Correlations
Pearson (pairwise, up to 20 columns)
and VIF for multicollinearity" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="444" width="420" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_target" value="5. Target analysis (if target_col is set)
numeric target: correlations, leakage check;
categorical target: eta association;
interactions with other columns" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="564" width="420" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_multi" value="6. Multivariate
PCA, KMeans clusters (k=3),
Isolation Forest outlier rows" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="564" width="220" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_opt" value="7. Optional modules
geo: lat/lon columns
time series: a date column
causal graph: PC algorithm
(causal-learn, eda extra)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="554" width="220" height="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_rules" value="8. Decision-tree rules (if target_col is set)
a surrogate tree on the target
turned into readable rules" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="698" width="420" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_alerts" value="Alerts
High Null, Constant,
High Cardinality, Possible ID,
PII (email/phone), Outlier,
Multicollinearity, Leakage, ..." style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="818" width="220" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_recs" value="Recommendations
Drop, Impute, Transform,
Encode, Resample" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="828" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_profile" value="DatasetProfile (one object)
columns, correlations, target results,
pca, clustering, outliers, causal_graph,
